To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

imidazole-1H-3-oxo-2,3-secocyclopropanol derivatives of betulonic acids have been synthesized for the first time, and that the antitumor activity of 3-3-hydroxy-iminolupen-20(29)ene-28-yl-lH-imidazole-l-carboxylate is significantly higher than the antitumor activities of betulonic and lupenonic acids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a search for a new class of compounds that are active against cancer cells.
the synthesis and the antineoplasmatic properties of betulonic imidazolide derivatives.
a new class of compounds, imidazolide derivatives of lupane, with a potential antineoplastic action.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the antineoplas-tic activity of the synthesized imidazolide of betulonic and lupane acids depends on the presence in cycle A of the 3-hydroximino group.
1H-imidazol-1-yl-3-hydroxyiminolup-20(22)-en-28-oate (3) is the most active antitumor compound in this series.
the imidazolide of betulonic acids containing the 3-oxolup-20(21)-en-28-oic acid moiety in the A-ring is the most promising antineoplastic agent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antineoplas-tic activity of lupane imidazolide depends on the structure of the substituents in the imidazole ring and on the structure of substituents in position 3 of the A-ring.
the antineoplasms of lupane C-28-1H-imida-zolides is determined by the structure of substituents at position C28 and the nature of the substituent at C3.
the imidazolide of betulonic acids containing 2-cy-ano-2, 3-seco-24(23)-ene fragment in the ring A has the highest antineoplasic activity in experiments in vivo and in vitro.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the imidazolide fragment in the C-28 position of betulonic acids is a promising pharmacophore.
imidazolide derivatives containing a lupane skeleton are promising candidates for antineoplastic drugs.
